description: This file provides basic interactivity for a tic-tac-toe game board, including hover effects and click logging on grid cells, intended to be used within a frontend web application.
external_files: The code references DOM elements with class 'cell' and attributes 'id' and 'data-cell', implying reliance on HTML/CSS files that define the board structure.

methods.name: initBoardInteractions()
methods.description: Sets up event listeners on all grid cells for hover effects, click logging, and keyboard interaction.
